title: Daily memory
description: Remember what changed, recover loose ends, and know exactly where to resume tomorrow.

blocks.title: Today in brief
blocks.intent: Summarize the most important work, decisions, and context from the current local calendar day. Stay source-backed and say when activity is sparse.

blocks.title: What I finished
blocks.intent: List concrete outcomes completed during the current local calendar day, using specific evidence rather than inferred progress.

blocks.title: Key moments
blocks.intent: Show the most consequential timestamped moments from the current local calendar day in chronological order.

blocks.title: Where I stopped
blocks.intent: List work that was active but unfinished at the end of the current local calendar day, including enough context to resume it.

blocks.title: Loose ends I may have missed
blocks.intent: Find explicit commitments, follow-ups, or unresolved tasks from the current local calendar day that may otherwise be missed.

blocks.title: Start here tomorrow
blocks.intent: Write a short, concrete starting point for the next work session based only on unfinished work and explicit loose ends from today.
